sources.title: GitHub - vantage-sh/models: Models but indexed by Vantage
sources.snippet: vantage.sh/models displays AI model pricing, benchmarks, and metadata from various cloud vendors in a single, queryable interface. Built with Astro, React, and Tailwind CSS, it features a client-side SQL engine (sql.js) for querying model data.
